content: प्रपञ्चः .²1 Display, manifestation; रागप्रायः प्रपञ्चः <ls>K. 151</ls>. .²2 Development, expansion, extension; भरतज्ञकविप्रणीतकाव्यग्रथिताङ्का इव नाटकप्रपञ्चाः <ls>Śi. 20. 44</ls>. .²3 Amplification, expatiation, explanation, elucidation. .²4 Prolixity, diffuseness, copiousness; अलं प्रपञ्चेन. .²5 Manifoldness, diversity. .²6 Heap, abundance, quantity. .²7 An appearance, phenomenon. .²8 Illusion, fraud. .²9 The visible world or universe, which is illusory and the scene of manifold action. .²10 Reciprocal false praise. .²11 Opposition, inversion. .²12 Analysis. .²13 (In <ab>dram.</ab>) Ludicrous dialogue. .²14 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The repetition of an obscure rule in a clearer form.
